# N — Category listings and add-ons page

**Specs:** `product-listing-page` (all four scenarios), `plp-led-catalog-navigation` (all ten scenarios; supersedes `product-detail-page`; header/mobile/banner scenarios are verified here by conformance tests against components built by I and O); consumes `configurable-offers-and-compatibility`, `offer-compatible-addons` (built by J), `mutually-exclusive-offers` (K), `cart-management` (M)
**Depends on:** H, I, J, M · **Unblocks:** O, P, Q, T (generated by verify-plan) · **Decisions:** D-004, D-010, D-011, D-012, D-014, D-016, D-017, D-018, D-019, D-022, D-024, D-025, D-026, D-050, D-052, D-053, D-055, D-056, D-058
**Owner prerequisites:** none for unit tests; OA-02 and OA-03 (seeded catalog, storefront API client) for the Chrome checks · **Skill refs:** `commercetools-storefront` (product-listing reference), `commercetools-platform`

## Goal
`/[locale]/shop/[slug]` lists every sellable offer of a category (cable internet, home wireless, phone plans, add-ons and their three sub-listings; the generic route also serves the devices category, whose cards are Q's) as cards the buyer can configure (term, add-ons, equipment, phone lines) and put into "My bundle" without leaving the page. Filter chip, sort and page live in the query string; one offer has one canonical link (`?offer=<key>`) that scrolls to and highlights its card.

## Design

Design source: `design/specs/plp.md`, `design/specs/addons.md`, `design/DESIGN.md` (components "Filter chip", "Plan card", "Add-on card"), `design/specs/shell.md`. Tokens only (no hex/px that a token carries; D-053).

### URL contract (route `app/[locale]/shop/[slug]/page.tsx`, Server Component)
`/[locale]/shop/<categorySlug>?filter=<chipId>&sort=<sortId>&page=<n>&offer=<offerKey>`
- `filter`: one chip id valid for the listing kind (below); otherwise ignored.
- `sort`: `default` (omitted) | `price-asc` | `price-desc`; anything else ignored. `default` = category order (offer `orderHint`, then name). Price = **master variant** embedded price (D-011).
- `page`: integer ≥ 1, default 1 (omitted). Not a number or < 1 → 1. **Larger than the last page → the last page is rendered** (no blank grid, no error), `<link rel="canonical">` points at the clamped URL.
- `offer`: an offer key. See "Canonical offer link".
- Parsing and serialising live in `lib/listing/params.ts` (N-01); `toQueryString` omits defaults and resets `page` when `filter` or `sort` changes.
- State is **only** in the URL (back button, pasted link and reload reproduce it). Chips and sort are real `Link`s / a `<form method="get">`-free client control that calls the locale-aware `router.replace` (no `useState` for filter/sort/page).

### Listing kinds and data
`listingKindForCategory(key)` in `lib/listing/kinds.ts`:
| Category key | Kind | Chip group | Count noun |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `malva-cat-cable-internet`, `malva-cat-home-wireless`, `malva-cat-phone-plans` | `plans` | per category (below) | "N plans" |
| `malva-cat-add-ons`, `malva-cat-streaming`, `malva-cat-protection` | `addons` | Music / Video / Extras | "N add-ons" |
| `malva-cat-equipment` | `addons` (all equipment) | none | "N items" |
| `malva-cat-devices` | `devices` | Q's | Q's |
| any other category key found in the tree | `plans` if its offers are `base-package`, else `addons` | none | "N plans" / "N add-ons" |

Offers shown = `getCategoryOffers(category.key, market, { includeDescendants: true })`, de-duplicated by `key`, then `isListable` (`lib/listing/visibility.ts`, N-02): audience contains `consumer`; `channels` empty or contains `online`; `startTime` null or ≤ now; `existingCustomer !== 'existing'` (existing-customer offers are not listed in v1; their eligibility is K's verdict at add time). **Planner default:** when several listable offers have the same `anchors`, keep only the unrestricted one (empty `channels`, `existingCustomer: 'any'`) so seeded `malva-offer-phone-online-only` does not duplicate Unlimited; the restricted one is still reachable via `?offer=`. Result with the seed: cable 3, wireless 3, phone 4, add-ons 13, streaming 5, protection 3, equipment 5.

### Filter chips (D-017; derived, never a hand-kept tag)
`lib/listing/facets.ts`, one pure predicate per chip on `Offer.plan` / `Offer.addon`:
| Kind / category | Chips (id → label en-US / de-DE) | Predicate |
| --- | --- | --- |
| phone | `all` All / Alle; `unlimited` Unlimited / Unbegrenzt; `data-capped` Data-capped / Datenlimit | `dataGb === -1`; `dataGb !== -1` |
| wireless | `all`; `5g` 5G / 5G; `lte` LTE / LTE | `networkGeneration === '5g'`; `=== '4g'` |
| cable | `all`; `up-to-500` Up to 500 Mbps / Bis 500 Mbit/s; `gig` 1 Gbps / 1 Gbit/s | `downstreamMbps <= 500`; `> 500` |
| add-ons / streaming / protection | `all`; `music` Music / Musik; `video` Video / Video; `extras` Extras / Extras | `addon.tag === 'music' \| 'video' \| 'extras'` (exact match; equipment has no tag so it is only under All) |
- Chips are mutually exclusive (one `filter` value). A chip whose count is 0 renders `aria-disabled="true"` (not removed); `all` is never disabled. The chip group is hidden when fewer than two chips (besides All) have count > 0 (equipment sub-listing).
- Click on the active chip or on `all` removes `filter`. "Filter resets to All on navigation" holds because the link to another category carries no query.
- `applyFacets(offers, filter)` and `facetCounts(offers, kind)` are generic over a list of groups (`FacetGroup[]`), so two groups can be active at once (`filter` today; the parser accepts additional group params declared in the group list). Only the design's one group is shipped. **Planner default:** no second facet and no price facet are shown (not in the design; 3–13 offers per category); the "two facets" behaviour is proven with synthetic groups in tests.
- **Add-on `tag`** is not an attribute in `telecom-catalog-model` (spec gap). **Planner default:** H's mapper fills `Offer.addon.tag` from an enum attribute `addon-tag` (`music` | `video` | `extras`) on `malva-addon`, added by G; see final report. N only reads `Offer.addon.tag`.

### Price modes (answers the `product-listing-page` open questions)
**Planner default:** prices are **embedded** on the offer's variants (D-011), so price **sort** is supported and a price facet would be possible; v1 offers price sort only (in memory over the already loaded, cached offer list; at most 13 offers per category) and **no price facet**. **No availability facet or availability indicator**: services have no InventoryEntry (D-019) and availability is doubly eventually consistent. Equipment cards show no stock state in v1 (an out-of-stock rule would be M's `lib/ct/availability.ts`; not used here). Sort control is undrawn: a small pill `<select>` "Sort" to the left of the count, shown only when the list has ≥ 2 offers; Junior design choice (D-068), documented here; one-line rationale in the PR/commit message.

Price is the same for every buyer in a market (no customer-group prices are seeded, D-058), so the card payload is cached whole per `(category, locale)`; a variant with `price === null` means no price for this buyer's currency/country: the card shows the muted text "Price not available" (de-DE "Preis nicht verfügbar"), no CTA (disabled button "Unavailable"/"Nicht verfügbar"), never 0 and never another currency.

### Page assembly (server)
1. `const { locale, slug } = await params; const sp = await searchParams; setRequestLocale(locale);`
2. `market` = the locale→market mapping of D (en-US → US/USD, de-DE → DE/EUR). If D exports no mapping function, N-04 creates `lib/config/market.ts` (N-owned) with exactly that table.
3. `tree = await getCategoryTree(locale)`; `resolveCategory(tree, slug, locale)` (`lib/listing/links.ts`): match `category.slug === slug`; else match any `category.slugs[other locale] === slug` and `redirect` (locale-aware) to the same path with the current locale's slug and the same query (language switch lands on the right slug); else `notFound()`.
4. `Promise.all([getCategoryOffers(...), getCategoryOffers('malva-cat-add-ons', market, {includeDescendants:true})])` (second call only for `plans` kind, feeds the pickers and the upsell band; same cached call, one network cost).
5. `state = resolveListingState({ offers, kind, params })` (N-03): filtered, sorted, paged slice, `pageCount`, `total`, `clampedPage`, `activeFilter`, `highlightKey`.
6. Render: `TitleStrip` (Breadcrumb + H1 + blurb) → `FilterBar` (chips, sort, count) → `AppliedFilters` (only when `filter` set) → `OfferGrid` → `Pagination` (only if `pageCount > 1`) → `UpsellBand` (plans kind) → nothing else. Empty states below.
7. `generateMetadata` (see SEO).
The server page never reads the session or the cart (cart state is client-side, so the page body stays cacheable); `Selected ✓` appears after hydration (`aria-busy` on the CTA until `useCart` has data).

### Canonical offer link
- `offerHref(offer, locale, tree)` → `/${locale}/shop/${primarySlug}?offer=${offer.key}#offer-${offer.key}` where **primary category = `offer.categoryKeys[0]`** (data rule: first assigned category). Locale-independent because the key is. P, O, I and the bundle (M) build offer links only with this function.
- Page with `?offer=<key>`: if the offer's primary category is **not** this category (e.g. `/shop/phone-plans?offer=malva-offer-cable-500`) → locale-aware `redirect` to the canonical URL. Unknown key → ignored (plain listing). If the offer exists in this listing but is hidden by `filter`, the filter is dropped for this render; if it is on another page than `page`, that page is rendered (`pageContaining(key)`), unless an explicit `page` was given.
- Card element `id="offer-<key>"`, `data-highlighted="true"` on the `?offer=` card: 3 px `--color-action` outline (`outline-offset` 4 px) plus `OfferAnchor` (client, `useEffect`) calling `scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' })` once; native `#` scrolling covers the no-JS case.

### Components (`components/offers/`, all owned by N)
- `OfferGrid` (server) → CSS grid `repeat(auto-fill, minmax(300px, 1fr))` for plans, `minmax(280px, 1fr)` for add-ons, gap `--space-7` (24). Passes one shared `ListingCandidates` object (add-on and equipment offers as plain data) to a client `ListingProvider` so it is serialised once, not per card.
- `OfferCard` (client; plan card): `Card` radius `--radius-xl`, 1px `--color-border`. Header `--color-brand-500`, padding 24: tag (Exo 600 12, min-height 16), name (Exo 700 26), price (Exo 700 40) + "/mo". Body padding 24, gap 16: ▸ bullets from `plan.highlights` (max 4; glyph `--color-pink-700`); hairline; validity line from the **selected variant** (initially the master); `TermSelector` (≥ 2 variants); phone only: `QuantityStepper` "Lines" 1–5 (D-014); CTA pill 2px `--color-action` border, Inter 800 15: **Choose plan** (outlined) ⇄ **Selected ✓** (filled, `--color-text-on-pink`), `aria-pressed`; "Customize" disclosure with `AddonPicker` + `EquipmentPicker`.
  - **Tag text** (derived, D-017): `[chipLabel(plan), badge === 'most-popular' ? 'Most popular' : null].filter(Boolean).join(' · ')` where `chipLabel` is the card's own chip label (e.g. "5G · Most popular", "Up to 500 Mbps").
  - **Validity line** from the selected variant's `contractTerm`: `month-to-month` "Month-to-month" / "Monatlich kündbar"; `12-months` "12-month price lock" / "12 Monate Preisgarantie"; `24-months` "24-month price lock" / "24 Monate Preisgarantie".
  - `TermSelector`: `role="radiogroup"`, pill radios "Month-to-month · $45.00" (label from the term message + variant price). Selecting changes price, validity line and the SKU used for adding. **Planner default:** radios are disabled while the plan is Selected (title "Deselect to change the contract term"); changing a term on a placed line would need remove + re-parenting and is not offered.
  - **Choose plan** flow = `useOfferSelection(offer)` (`components/offers/useOfferSelection.ts`, client):
    1. `POST /api/offers/compatibility { offerKey }`. `verdict: 'ok'` → continue. `blocked` with a conflict reason → `ConfirmReplace` dialog naming the held offer ("Replace Cable 500 with Air 5G?"); on confirm remove the named `lineItemIds` then continue; cancel → nothing changes. Any other blocked reason → inline error under the CTA with the reason message (`offers.reason.<code>`), cart untouched (D-022: absolute).
    2. Same-category replacement: cart lines whose `offerKey` is among **this listing's** offer keys and `kind === 'plan'` (a different plan of this category) are removed first. If that line has dependents (add-ons/equipment with `parentLineItemId`), the `ConfirmReplace` dialog says "Switching removes N add-ons" (D-026).
    3. `addLineItem({ offerKey, sku: selectedVariant.sku, quantity: lines })` (phone `quantity` = stepper value, others 1).
    4. If `plan.requiredEquipmentKinds` is non-empty: `defaultEquipment(...)` (J, D-025) → `addLineItem({ offerKey: equipment.key, sku: <rental variant sku, else first>, quantity: 1, parentLineItemId: <new plan line id> })`.
    5. Toast "Added to My bundle". Header count updates through M's `useCart` (no N code).
    - **Selected ✓** click = `removeLineItem(planLine.id)` (M cascades dependents); if dependents exist, `ConfirmReplace` variant "Remove {name} and its {n} add-ons?" first.
    - Quantity change while Selected = `setLineQuantity(planLine.id, q)`; while not Selected only local state.
    - Calls run **sequentially** (await each) and the CTA is `disabled` + `aria-busy` while any is pending (avoids cart version conflicts).
  - Selected state is derived (`cart.lineItems.find(l => l.offerKey === offer.key && l.kind === 'plan')`), never stored in component state.
- `AddonPicker` / `EquipmentPicker` (client; inside "Customize", **enabled only while the plan is Selected**; before that a muted hint "Choose this plan to add extras"):
  - Candidates are the shared add-on / equipment offers; each is run through `evaluateCandidate(planFacts, candidateFacts, { cartOfferKeys })` in the browser (data passed from the server, D-024). Result states: `family` mismatch → **not listed**; `included` → row "Apple TV+ · Included" with a check icon, checkbox disabled and checked; `speed`/`technology`/`exception`/`exclusive` → row **disabled with reason text** (undrawn state, Junior design choice per D-068: muted row, `aria-disabled`, reason in `--text-xs`/`--color-text-muted`, e.g. "Supports less than the plan delivers"); otherwise selectable.
  - Add-on row = checkbox + name + price "/mo". Checking calls `addLineItem({ offerKey, sku, quantity: 1, parentLineItemId: planLine.id })`; unchecking calls `removeLineItem(addonLine.id)`. A server rejection (`ApiError`) restores the checkbox and shows the returned reason text in the row (spec: "Server re-checks what the card allowed").
  - Equipment rows are radios per `(equipment, variant)` ("Malva WiFi 6 Router AX3000 · Rent $x/mo" / "Buy $y"), grouped by `equipmentKind`; the defaulted one is pre-checked after Choose plan; choosing another removes the previous equipment line of that kind then adds the new one (sequential).
  - Reason copy (`offers.reason.*`): `speed` "Supports less than the plan delivers" / "Unterstützt weniger, als der Tarif liefert"; `technology` "Does not work with this service" / "Funktioniert nicht mit diesem Dienst"; `family` "Not available for this kind of plan" / "Für diese Tarifart nicht verfügbar"; `included` "Already included" / "Bereits enthalten"; `exception` "Declared incompatible" / "Als nicht kompatibel hinterlegt"; `exclusive` "Cannot be held with the other offer" / "Nicht mit dem anderen Angebot kombinierbar"; `needsPlan` "Needs a compatible plan in your bundle" / "Benötigt einen kompatiblen Tarif im Bundle".
- `AddonCard` (client; add-ons page): Card radius `--radius-xl`; banner 120 px `--color-pink-900` with the offer name (Exo 700 40 → `--text-5xl`, `--color-text-on-pink`, 1px tracking, ellipsis at 2 lines); body padding 24: tag (Exo 600 12, `--color-pink-700`; equipment shows the kind label), description (first `highlights` item; else none), hairline, price (Exo 700 22) + " /mo" (muted 14; purchase-only equipment shows "one time"), toggle CTA **Add to bundle** (outlined) ⇄ **Added ✓** (filled). No logos (design D5).
  - Toggle ON: parent resolution: candidate parents = cart plan lines for which `evaluateCandidate` is `available`; **first in cart order** is the parent (unambiguous, spec "Same add on different offer"); `addLineItem({ ..., parentLineItemId })`. No available parent → the card shows the **needs-plan state** (undrawn, Junior design choice per D-068): CTA disabled "Needs a plan", reason `needsPlan`, link "Choose a plan" to `offerHref`-less category link (`internet` family → cable-internet listing, `phone` → phone-plans listing, built by `categoryHref(key)`). A parent exists but the candidate is unavailable for all (e.g. router too slow) → disabled with the first reason.
  - Toggle OFF: `removeLineItem(addonLine.id)`. Selected state = a cart line with this `offerKey` and `kind` addon/equipment.
- `AddonsAttachedHint`: on a plan card the picker also shows a link "Browse all add-ons" (`/shop/add-ons`) — "same add-ons remain separately browsable".
- `FilterChips` (client, `Link`-based chips; pill, `--radius-pill`; default `--color-brand-100` bg / `--color-brand-950` text; active `--color-brand-950` bg with white text per DESIGN; chip Exo 600 14), `SortSelect`, `ResultCount` ("{count, plural, ...}" right-aligned, `role="status"`), `AppliedFilters` (removable pill with ✕ per active filter; each is a `Link` that drops that param).
- `Pagination` (server, shared with P): `<nav aria-label>`: Previous · numbers (ellipsis when > 7 pages) · Next; current `aria-current="page"`; real URLs preserving other params (`basePath`, `params`). Renders nothing for one page.
- `UpsellBand` (plans kind only): `--color-pink-50` band, `--radius-xl`, "Make it yours with add-ons" / "{names} and more can be added to any plan." (`names` = first two streaming add-on offer names in category order, joined with " and ") + pill link "Browse add-ons" → `/shop/add-ons`.
- `ListingEmpty`: heading + text + links to the other top-level categories from the tree (never a blank page). Two variants: **empty category** (no listable offers: "Nothing here yet" / "Hier gibt es noch nichts") and **no match** (facet removed state, below).
- `DeviceListingSlot`: for kind `devices` N renders the generic `OfferGrid` without pickers; Q **replaces the import in `page.tsx`** (append-only change by Q).

### Empty and edge states
- Facet combination with no matches: heading "No plans match these filters" (add-ons: "No add-ons match these filters"), the active chips stay visible in `AppliedFilters` with ✕, plus "Clear filters" link. Count "0 plans".
- Empty category: `ListingEmpty` "Nothing here yet", with links "Phone plans · Wireless internet · Cable internet · Add-ons" from the tree (excluding the current category), status 200.
- Unknown slug (any locale): `notFound()` → I's standard not-found page (HTTP 404).
- `/[locale]/p/<x>`, `/[locale]/product/<x>`, `/[locale]/products/<x>`, `/[locale]/shop` (no slug), `/[locale]/shop/<slug>/<extra>` are **not routes** (no files); the catch-all of I renders not-found. `/[locale]/shop` alone: **Planner default** 404 (the header and tiles always link to a category; `shop/` is only a prefix, D-052).
- Offer in two categories: only the primary category's listing contains the offer's canonical link; it still appears in both lists (membership), but every generated link targets the primary.

### Navigation conformance (header, mobile, banners)
`plp-led-catalog-navigation` requires the header and home to be derived from the category tree. The components belong to I (`SiteHeader`, `MobileDrawer`) and O (promo and category tiles); N writes **conformance tests only** (new test files, no change to their sources): header shows top-level categories in `orderHint` order with children as submenu entries in the buyer's locale; a category added to the mocked tree appears with no code change ("cache window" = H's cached read, proven by calling the loader with a changed fixture after advancing fake timers past the TTL named in `lib/config/cache.ts`); the drawer renders the same order. If one fails because I/O built it from literals, stop and ask (QUESTIONS.md) — do not patch their files.

### SEO and metadata (`generateMetadata`)
- `title`: `"{category name} | Malva Telecom"` (`meta.listing.title`), `description`: category description or the blurb message, ≤ 160 chars.
- `alternates.canonical`: `/${locale}/shop/${slug}` plus `?page=N` only when `N > 1`; filters, sort and `offer` are not part of the canonical URL. `alternates.languages`: `{ 'en-US': …, 'de-DE': … }` each with that locale's slug from `category.slugs`.
- `openGraph.images`: category image if present. `robots`: default; clamped/redirected duplicates are not indexed because of the canonical.
- Unknown category: `title: 'Not found'` is irrelevant (`notFound()` throws first).

### de-DE slugs
Slugs are the localized commercetools `slug` of each category (G seeds them). N never hard-codes slugs: it reads `category.slug`. Chrome checks reach de-DE pages by clicking the header link (not by typing a guessed slug).

### Pitfalls
- **Locale-aware navigation only:** `Link`, `redirect`, `useRouter` from `@/i18n/routing`; never `next/link`. Never wrap `redirect()`/`notFound()` in `try/catch`.
- `searchParams` and `params` are Promises in Next 16: `await` both. `export const dynamic` is not set; the route is dynamic because of `searchParams`; cost is low because H's reads are cached.
- **Hydration:** nothing cart-dependent in the server render; the first client render equals the server HTML (`Choose plan`), then SWR fills in. Do not read `localStorage`.
- **Version conflicts:** M's cart is versioned; never fire two cart writes in parallel (task N-07 awaits each; test asserts order).
- **Money:** only H's `formatMoney`; never `toFixed`. Cable "$39.99" is `3999` cents.
- Speed band edges: `downstreamMbps` 500 belongs to "Up to 500 Mbps" (`<= 500`), 1000 to "1 Gbps".
- Do not filter by the plan's `tag` text (the prototype did); derive from attributes (D-017).
- A server page may not export extra values; shared helpers live in `lib/listing/*`.
- The `offer=` redirect must happen before rendering to avoid a flash; compute it in the server page.
- Images: Pexels host allow-list is configured by G/A in `next.config.ts`; N uses `next/image` with `sizes`; alt text from `ImageRef.alt` (which names the photographer, `seed-product-images-pexels`). Category image is optional (token-coloured placeholder when absent, D-055).
